steps.text: Connections Verified: Connections Verified successfully. Now turn ON the MCB by clicking the MCB lever.
MCB has been turned ON. Select the resistor, inductor, and capacitor values, then click the power button of the autotransformer.
The autotransformer is now ON at 30 volts. The selected meter reading is displayed and the Add button is enabled.
The voltage has been set to 30 V. The readings are displayed on the voltmeter, ammeter, and wattmeter. Click Add to record the selected reading.
Reading added successfully. Select a different R-L-C combination for the next reading. The MCB and autotransformer will remain ON, and Add will become available for the new reading.
This reading is already in the table. Select a different R-L-C combination to enable Add again. Verification becomes available after five readings.
